items.title: Why Corning (GLW) Is Up 7.6% After Strong Q2 Results And AI-Focused Guidance

The company paired these results with guidance calling for further year-over-year growth in third-quarter core sales and earnings, reinforcing investors’ focus on its role in supplying materials for data centers...
